missions.name: In the Beginning
missions.label: Introduction
missions.description: Carl Johnson returns to Los Santos after living in Liberty City for five years. His brother Sweet Johnson informs him about his mother's death. When he reaches home, he gets captured by C.R.A.S.H.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Intro & Mission #1 - Big Smoke, Sweet & Kendl (HD)

missions.name: Big Smoke
missions.description: Carl enters his home at Grove Street, where he recalls his childhood memories and finds his deceased mother's photo. Carl reunites with his childhood friend Big Smoke, who promises to avenge his mother's death by finding the killer.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Intro & Mission #1 - Big Smoke, Sweet & Kendl (HD)

missions.name: Sweet & Kendl
missions.description: Carl and Big Smoke go to a cemetery, where Carl reunites with his siblings Sweet and Kendl. Sweet blames Carl for their mother's death and explains what happened when Carl fled the city. As the gang leaves the cemetery, they are ambushed by the Ballas.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Intro & Mission #1 - Big Smoke, Sweet & Kendl (HD)

missions.name: Ryder
missions.description: Carl reunites with Ryder at his house on Grove Street. Ryder suggests that Carl should improve his physical appearance, so he makes him get a haircut. Afterwards, they try to deal with a pizzeria owner who keeps on spraying over Grove Street tags.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #2 - Ryder (HD)

missions.name: Tagging Up Turf
missions.description: Carl visits Sweet and Big Smoke at Sweet's house. Sweet questions Carl about what made him return to the hood, and gives him a spray can to let him spray over some enemy graffiti. Sweet, however, changes his mind and decides to help him.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #3 - Tagging up Turf (HD)

missions.name: Cleaning the Hood
missions.description: Sweet, Big Smoke and Ryder are discussing the rise in crack cocaine in the city. After a brief argument, Ryder and CJ decide to take care of the business. Take out a drug dealer in the territory of the Grove and assault a Ballas crack den.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #4 - Cleaning the Hood (HD)

missions.name: Drive-Thru
missions.description: Big Smoke, Sweet, and Ryder go to eat, and CJ joins them. They head to Cluckin' Bell and get some orders. While eating, they spot the same Ballas who chased them earlier heading towards Grove Street.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #5 - Drive-thru (HD)

missions.name: Nines and AK's
missions.description: CJ finds out that Grove Street Families currently have no weapons to defend themselves. Big Smoke and CJ go to pay a visit to Emmet, a member of Seville Boulevard Families, to practice some shooting.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #6 - Nines and AK's (HD)

missions.name: Drive-By
missions.description: Ryder complains about CJ's driving skills, saying that CJ always crashes cars. Sweet, however, allows CJ to drive, while he, Ryder, and Big Smoke will ride shotgun. The gang drives to a territory of the Ballas for a drive-by.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #7 - Drive-By (HD)

missions.name: Sweet's Girl
missions.description: CJ gets a phone call from Sweet who says that he and his girlfriend are trapped by the Seville Boulevard Families. CJ heads to rescue them before they die. Save Sweet and his girl from an onslaught of the Seville Boulevard Families gang members.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #8 - Sweet's Girl (HD)

missions.name: Cesar Vialpando
missions.description: Sweet and Kendl argue about Kendl's relationship with Mexican gangster Cesar Vialpando, the Varrios Los Aztecas leader. Sweet tells Carl to keep an eye on her to avoid any danger. Win the Lowrider Challenge.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #9 - Cesar Vialpando (HD)

missions.name: Home Invasion
missions.description: Ryder can't find the drugs he buried inside his lawn. He asks Carl to steal weapon crates from a war veteran living in East Beach. At 22:00, they go for the robbery. Rob a war veteran living in East Beach for weapons crates.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #10 - Home Invasion (HD)

missions.name: Catalyst
missions.description: After failing to find the stuff he buried, Ryder prepares his drugs. C.R.A.S.H. arrives and informs that an ammo train will be arriving shortly at East Los Santos.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #11 - Catalyst (HD)

missions.name: Robbing Uncle Sam
missions.description: Ryder tells CJ that the army has many weapons. They both head to an army base in Ocean Docks to steal the army weapons. Raid a National Guard base in the Ocean Docks area.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #12 - Robbing Uncle Sam (HD)

missions.name: OG Loc
missions.description: OG Loc is released from prison and CJ, Sweet, and Big Smoke go to the police station to pick him up. Loc reveals that a Mexican gangster, Freddy, raped him in jail and stole his rhymes. Loc goes to confront Freddy at his house.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #13 - OG Loc (HD)

missions.name: Running Dog
missions.description: Smoke tells CJ that his cousin is arriving in the city from Mexico and he's going to pick her up. CJ and Smoke drive to East Los Santos where they confront two Vagos gangsters. After an argument between them, Smoke kills one member while CJ chases the other.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #14 - Running Dog (HD)

missions.name: Wrong Side of the Tracks
missions.description: Smoke informs CJ about a deal between the Vagos and San Fierro Rifa and decides to crash their meeting. After arriving at Unity Station, however, the Vagos attempt to escape by train, and Smoke and CJ give chase to stop them.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #15 - Wrong Side of the Tracks (HD)

missions.name: Just Business
missions.description: Big Smoke has some business to take care of and goes with CJ to the Atrium in Commerce. After getting inside, they fight against the Russian Mafia. Help Big Smoke fight against the Russian Mafia in the Atrium and then escape from them using the sewer system.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #16 - Just Business (HD)

missions.name: Life's a Beach
missions.description: CJ visits OG Loc, who is working at the Burger Shot in Marina. Loc is planning to host a house party, but he lacks a sound system. He tells CJ to steal a sound van from a beach party. Steal a sound system Pony for OG Loc's house party.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #17 - Life's a Beach (HD)

missions.name: Madd Dogg's Rhymes

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #18 - Madd Dogg's Rhymes (HD)

missions.name: Management Issues
missions.description: Now that Loc has what he wants for his party, he still isn't satisfied. Loc reveals that Madd Dogg's manager Alan Crawford is preventing Loc from getting into music, becoming Loc's huge problem. Loc wants the manager killed.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #19 - Management Issues (HD)

missions.name: House Party
missions.description: OG Loc quits the janitor job and decides to go back to prison, but wants to have the party before. He tells CJ to prepare everything for the party. CJ visits the party, but soon gets warned about an incoming attack from the Ballas on Grove Street.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #20 - House Party (HD)

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #21 - Burning Desire (HD)

missions.name: Gray Imports
missions.description: Tenpenny informs CJ about a deal between the Ballas and Russians at the warehouse in Ocean Docks, and orders CJ to destroy the deal by killing the dealer. Kill a Russian arms dealer.

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #22 - Gray Imports (HD)

missions.name: Doberman

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #23 - Doberman (HD)

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #24 - Los Sepulcros (HD)

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #25 - High Stakes, Low-rider (HD)

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #26 - Reuniting the Families (HD)

video.vt: GTA San Andreas - Walkthrough - Mission #27 - The Green Sabre (HD)
